title: Dev — Feature development (daily)
description: Dev-centric flow: Ingest spec → Plan → Execute → Verify. No separate Review/Deliver (use default for full gates).

steps.title: Ingest spec
steps.notes: Sub-workflow `phase.ingest`: read sources then lock scope in `.vibe/research/<task-id>.md`. Use `phase.spec.brainstorm` only when the spec is fuzzy (L1b) — see read-sources skill. No PLAN.md in this phase.

steps.title: Plan

variants.label: Detailed plan
variants.description: Large task or multiple domains (skips duplicate load-spec; ingest already ran).

steps.notes: PLAN.md from research; default sub_workflow: plan.post-ingest (no duplicate task_context after ingest). No production code until the plan is stable.

steps.title: Execute & Review
steps.notes: TDD per implement step; two-layer review per review_slice step.

steps.title: Test & compliance
steps.notes: Tests + verify_compliance; on_failure see hints in the verify phase.
